listing.name: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition (GemRB)
listing.summary: GemRB has experimental support for Baldur’s Gate II: Enhanced Edition, separate from its original-edition support. Use your own installed Enhanced Edition data; exact compatible EE revisions and builds remain unconfirmed. The project offers SourceForge Windows, Linux and macOS archives, Flatpak and source-build instructions. Configure GamePath or the positional game directory for your chosen supported build. Historical/source Linux targets include x86, x86-64, PPC and MIPS, but this guide has not selected or confirmed a package architecture. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
